title: Understanding the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, denoted as \( \sigma(z) \), is defined as \( \sigma(z) $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \). It maps any real-valued number into the range $$(0,1)$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: To find \( $$z$$ \), calculate the linear combination of the features and the parameters: \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_1$$ \cdot \text{hue} + $$\theta_2$$ \cdot \text{abv} \).

title: Substitute the Values
text: Substitute the given values into the linear combination: \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ \cdot \frac{1}{4} + $$1$$ \cdot $$(-2)$$ \).

title: Apply the Logistic Function
text: Now that you have \( $$z$$ $$=$$ $$-1.5$$ \), apply the logistic function: \( \gamma $$=$$ $$\sigma(-1.5)$$ $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{1.5}} \).

title: Interpret the Result
text: The value of \( \gamma \) represents the probability that Billywine is a type $$1$$ wine. If \( \gamma \) is closer to $$1$$, it is more likely to be type 1; if closer to $$0$$, it is more likely to be type $$0$$.
